valid_talents.name: Brick Wall
valid_talents.official_desc: You refuse. You cannot be knocked off your feet until you are knocked completely Unconscious. Also reduces the duration of Knockdown.

valid_talents.name: Exoskeleton
valid_talents.official_desc: You have a layer of fortified Natural Armor that replenishes when you rest. Your Natural Armor will resist 10% Physical Damage when active.

valid_talents.name: To the Finish
valid_talents.official_desc: You take 10% less damage when below 30% health.

valid_talents.name: Collapsed Lung
valid_talents.official_desc: Block breaking an opponent closes off their ability to Vent for 8s, with this duration scaling with Strength. PvE enemies instead get Collapsed.

valid_talents.name: Showstopper
valid_talents.official_desc: When an enemy would roll through one of your physical attacks, stomp the ground, dazing anyone nearby. Removes speed buffs from target upon landing.

valid_talents.name: Ghost
valid_talents.official_desc: Dodging a move will briefly make you invisible, ending early if you attack.

valid_talents.name: Speed Demon
valid_talents.official_desc: Your attacks now inflict a reduced-strength bleed while you have a speed boost. 1s cooldown.

valid_talents.name: Conditioned Runner
valid_talents.official_desc: You regenerate health faster than normal when sprinting below 75% HP. The health amount scales with your agility stat.

valid_talents.name: Underdog
valid_talents.official_desc: You deal 2.5% more damage to those with higher HP than you, scaling up to 4% at 60 WLL. Additionally, you deal +10% more damage to physically larger foes.

valid_talents.name: Tough Love
valid_talents.official_desc: Deal 10% more damage to enemies Charmed by you. Mantras deal +5% instead. Being hit by someone the same Aspect or Oath as you applies Charmed briefly.

valid_talents.name: Charismatic Cast
valid_talents.official_desc: Landing a hit with a mantra on an enemy applies Charmed. Allies recover from being knocked twice as quickly when Charmed by you.

valid_talents.name: Chaotic Charm (D3)
valid_talents.official_desc: Charm enemies nearby when attacked at low health. Enemies affected by this charm have their damage increased to anyone but you, and deal reduced damage towards you.

valid_talents.name: Nullifying Clarity
valid_talents.official_desc: Deal 10% more damage to enemies with elemental status effects, but remove the status on hit.

valid_talents.name: Eureka
valid_talents.official_desc: Gain a stack of Inspiration every time you land or parry a Mantra. Whiffing a Mantra removes a stack of Inspiration. Reaching 3 stacks grants +10% Mantra Damage to your next Mantra attack.

valid_talents.name: Grand Feast
valid_talents.official_desc: Regain tempo, ether, blood and health when gaining hunger from killing.

valid_talents.name: Azure Flames
valid_talents.official_desc: Many of your flames turn blue, signifying their increased intensity.
